explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 97 named tracks/releases across Juno's September 14 current-techno pages, the September minimal/tech-house chart, today's new techno listings and the linked reissue/catalogue window. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized without creating a blanket intensity or genre ban.

Completed discovery Runs 243–247 and persistent target/global discovery state were compared before ranking. Previously evaluated, parked, rejected, unresolved, duplicate and exact-alternate identities were excluded.
All ranked artist/title pairs were checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger; none was found.

The three top-ranked leads come from distinct releases and test distinct non-frozen current boundaries. No proposed placement touches either protected internal handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
Current listings with generic release-level framing, no individual-track proposition, or a recently repeated placement hypothesis were deprioritized rather than padded into the top slots.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Chris Pascoe, Daniel Poli — Cross The Eyes
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: DJ Natas — Natas Spin EP, released September 14, 2026 on UFO Series, individually described by Juno. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/today/

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Juno Recommends Minimal/Tech House: September 2026, including Terry Francis and Satoshi Tomiie material whose swing, breaks, dub reduction and rhythmic movement plausibly cross into the volume lens. https://www.juno.co.uk/charts/juno-recommends/631037-Juno_Recommends_Minimal_Tech/33361873-Chart

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / REISSUE WINDOW: Creature — Tom's D / Orbitar, Chris Pascoe & Daniel Poli — Cross The Eyes and The Real — Debbie Does Deptford, newly recirculated in 2026 reissues of older UK/European club material on Juno's September chart. https://www.juno.co.uk/charts/juno-recommends/631037-Juno_Recommends_Minimal_Tech/33361873-Chart
